summary: Kept, lakefront confirmed (A06-A09/A12-A17 W/E and C30-C37 primitive on open lawn ~10-20 m from the shore line). Fees now $29-55 (Campspot 2027: primitive $29-43, W/E $35-55); season 04-16..11-29; 60 sites (20 W/E); showers + dump; military 10%. Operator BrightSky (Common-Cap LLC). rec.gov 233583 is deactivated, Campspot is the only booking channel.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront kept, checked hard): the north row of the campground (Campspot A12-A17 along the NW shore and A06-A09 at the north tip, all 'Standard RV Site' 50A W/E sold nightly on Campspot) and the west point (primitive C30-C37) sit on open, lightly treed lawn. On Esri imagery (leaf-off, lake drawn down) the tip pads at ~37.2856,-85.2925 end ~10-17 m from the vegetated high-water edge, with no tree belt between.
